name: BackdropTransform
description: Strategy describing how the content behind a sheet or drawer is transformed while it opens.
notes: No <name>_style.dart / <name>_theme.dart: the transform is a strategy object configured by its constructor, not a themed widget. The only theme-derived value is the root corner radius, read from ShadcnTheme at wrap time.
resolveExtraSize no longer divides by minScale for the root layer; that formula was algebraically zero for every t.
